name: Polish Layer
summary: Polish Layer is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies and trades in the direction of the prevailing market trend using layered technical indicators. It enters positions when multiple trend confirmation signals align and manages trades with trailing stops and partial closings. The EA applies a multi-layer filtering approach to reduce false signals in ranging markets.
summary_zh: Polish Layer是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过多层技术指标确认来识别并追随市场主趋势方向入场交易。当多个趋势确认信号对齐时开仓，并使用移动止损和部分平仓来管理持仓。该EA采用多层过滤方法来减少震荡市场中的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis: Polish Layer策略的核心概念是多层趋势过滤，通过叠加多个趋势判断指标来提高信号的可靠性。入场条件要求至少两个或以上的趋势指标同时确认同方向信号才会触发交易，例如移动平均线方向、MACD信号线交叉和价格突破确认。出场条件采用分步出场机制，包括达到固定止盈目标的部分平仓和追踪止损保护利润。仓位管理基于账户可用资金的固定比例计算手数，避免过度杠杆。资金管理方面设置了最大同时持仓数量限制和单笔最大亏损百分比限制来控制整体风险。该策略在强趋势行情中表现优异，但在震荡整理行情中可能因频繁假突破而产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Polish Layer strategy is multi-layer trend filtering, which improves signal reliability by stacking multiple trend-determining indicators. Entry conditions require at least two or more trend indicators to simultaneously confirm the same directional signal before triggering a trade, such as moving average direction alignment, MACD signal line crossover, and price breakout confirmation. Exit conditions employ a stepped exit mechanism, including partial closes at fixed take-profit targets and trailing stop protection to lock in profits. Position sizing is calculated based on a fixed percentage of account available margin, avoiding excessive leverage. Money management incorporates limits on maximum simultaneous open positions and a maximum loss percentage per trade to control overall portfolio risk. The strategy excels in strong trending markets but may produce consecutive losses in choppy, range-bound conditions due to frequent false breakouts.
pros: 多层趋势过滤机制有效减少虚假信号，提高了入场质量
分步出场策略兼顾了利润捕获和风险控制，不会一次性全部平仓
风险控制参数完善，包括最大持仓限制和单笔风险百分比限制
pros_en: Multi-layer trend filtering mechanism effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Stepped exit strategy balances profit capture and risk control without closing all positions at once
Comprehensive risk control parameters including maximum position limits and per-trade risk percentage limits
cons: 在震荡行情中多层过滤仍可能产生连续虚假信号导致回撤
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能不够灵活
缺少交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: Multi-layer filtering can still produce consecutive false signals in ranging markets leading to drawdowns
Fixed pip-based stop loss and take profit does not account for volatility changes, lacking flexibility in high-volatility periods
Lacks trading session filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动率动态调整止损止盈距离
添加交易时段过滤和波动率过滤器，避免在低流动性或低波动时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop loss and take profit to dynamically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add trading session filter and volatility filter to avoid trading during low-liquidity or low-volatility periods

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑波动率，极端行情下可能产生较大滑点损失
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit without volatility consideration may cause significant slippage losses in extreme market conditions
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions within the same candle
